_help: Owner data for the legal pages (docs/legal) and /.well-known/security.txt. Fill in every empty value before publishing; empty values are shown as highlighted [placeholders]. Build with LEGAL_STRICT=1 to fail while any remains. See docs/legal/README.md.

owner._help: Titular of the website (LSSI-CE art. 10) and data controller (GDPR art. 13.1.a). phone and registry are optional (registry: only for companies or registered entities).
owner.name: Pablo Gallego Falcón

dpo._help: Data Protection Officer (GDPR arts. 37-39, LOPDGDD art. 34). Leave both empty when none is designated: the texts then say so and give privacyEmail. Mandatory for public bodies and schools that deploy their own instance.

_jurisdiction_help: jurisdiction: optional forum clause (e.g. 'los juzgados y tribunales de Pontevedra'); empty = the courts that correspond under the applicable law.

hosting._help: Who serves the static files. Defaults describe GitHub Pages; change them for a school or Consellería server. Any value can be a plain string or one per language ({"es": …, "gl": …, "en": …, "fr": …, "de": …}).

transfers.es: el Marco de Privacidad de Datos UE-EE. UU.
transfers.gl: o Marco de Privacidade de Datos UE-EUA
transfers.fr: le cadre de protection des données UE-États-Unis
transfers.de: den Datenschutzrahmen EU-USA (EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework)

accessibility._help: Accessibility statement (RD 1112/2018). status: 'partial' (until an audit says otherwise), 'full' or 'none'. method: 'self' (self-assessment) or 'audit' (external audit). reviewedOn: optional. complaintBody: only for public-sector owners (the body that handles accessibility complaints); empty = private owner, voluntary statement.

security._help: security.txt (RFC 9116). contact: a mailto: or https: URI. expires: ISO date; empty = build date + 180 days. policy: optional URL.
